title: agalinis oligophylla
intro: Agalinis oligophylla, commonly known as Red-stemmed Agalinis, is a perennial plant species native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of acting as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Agalinis oligophylla include reducing inflammation, relieving cough, and soothing respiratory tract irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
